89j.verdict: A row of thin skeletal marionette figures swaying gently on a dark ground in a restrained sepia palette — the chorus-of-bodies concept and earth-toned restraint are appealing, but the stick figures are too thin and small, leaving most of the frame empty and the forms reading as faint scribbles rather than substantial bodies.
89j.resembles: Magdalena Abakanowicz — 'Agora' crowd of standing headless figures

8rx.verdict: A tiny, faint wisp of sparse particles drifts in a vast near-empty dusk canvas, occupying well under 10% of frame and barely legible; the slow drift reads as contemplative but there is no form to follow.
8rx.resembles: a distant sparse star cluster / faint Orion nebula wisp

99w.verdict: A thin green-gold particle filament hangs vertically in a vast black void, occupying far under 10% of the frame; motion across tiles is nearly imperceptible, so it reads as a faint static streak rather than a growing or living form.

9go.verdict: A thin, nearly-flat horizontal ribbon of multicolored dashes that barely breathes across the loop — the form is a forgettable sliver occupying well under 10% of a vast empty canvas, and the red/blue/gold/teal mix reads as scattered rather than a restrained palette.

a7l.verdict: A near-empty dusk-to-night gradient with a scatter of faint star-points and no legible form, growth, or attractor; motion is imperceptible across all six tiles, so nothing reads as intentional structure.
a7l.resembles: a generic dusk skybox gradient (Turrell-lite atmospheric wash without the form)

a8q.verdict: A fuzzy teal particle blob with only a faint hourglass pinch reads as an ambient noise cloud rather than an intentional form, and the motion is just a slow breathe-and-fade with no structure emerging. Restrained duotone palette is its one redeeming quality.
a8q.resembles: diffuse curl-noise nebula cloud (the ac2 failure mode)

aws.verdict: Frames are almost entirely black with only faint speckle noise and a barely-visible horizontal smudge in frame one; no form ever settles and there is no readable motion across the loop. This is an effectively empty/failed render.
aws.resembles: a near-black sensor-noise field — like an underexposed long-exposure of an empty night sky

b4z.verdict: A sparse scaffold of faint straightedge lines and tiny right-angle markers drifting almost imperceptibly across a near-empty cream canvas; the form reads as unresolved construction geometry rather than an intentional shape, and the motion is so slight it barely registers.

b5n.verdict: A single thin vertical filament floats in a near-black void, occupying well under 10% of frame with no discernible form, mass, or silhouette; across all six tiles it barely changes, so there is no readable motion or growth either. This is an essentially empty render, not a piece.
b5n.resembles: a lone seismograph trace / single strand of spider silk

beo.verdict: A soft glittering oval haze that breathes and drifts slightly but never resolves into any silhouette or structure — the textbook ambient nebula-blob failure mode, with motion limited to gentle pulsing.
beo.resembles: a diffuse star cluster / Pleiades nebulosity

bqf.verdict: A single hair-thin vertical column of green-flecked particles stranded in a vast black void — it occupies well under 10% of the frame and barely changes across the loop, reading as static and near-empty rather than a deliberate form.
bqf.resembles: The Matrix digital rain (falling code column)

bt6.verdict: A flat, blown-out white disc on black with no internal structure and no legible motion across all six frames — reads as an overexposed sphere or broken render, not an intentional form. The faint specks and bottom-edge smudge never resolve into anything readable.
bt6.resembles: an overexposed full moon / blank lunar disc photograph

c0q.verdict: Scattered tiny ink blobs and short comma-tail squiggles drift slowly across a vast empty cream field, never resolving into a coherent form and occupying well under 10% of frame; the restrained bone-on-ink palette is the only real asset. Motion is an unhurried gentle drift but there is no structure for it to reveal.

c65.verdict: All six frames are an empty dusk-to-ink vertical gradient with zero particles or structure — no form ever appears and nothing changes across the loop, reading as a blank or failed render.
c65.resembles: Mark Rothko — Untitled (dark color-field), but absent any subject

ceb.verdict: A thin diagonal smear of sparse particles that barely changes across the loop, reading as a faint scratch rather than a form; the near-static drift leaves most of the cream canvas empty and the subject well under 10% of frame.
ceb.resembles: a single graphite pencil stroke / Vija Celmins faint diagonal mark

d1s.verdict: A fuzzy grayscale particle puff with no recognizable silhouette that reads as ambient noise mush, then disperses into a near-empty frame for the back half of the loop, leaving illegible structure and dead space.

e95.verdict: A faint perspective grid of tiny squares — like a receding woven mesh — but washed out in near-zero cream-on-cream contrast and barely legible; motion is so minimal across the loop it reads as static texture rather than living form.
e95.resembles: Agnes Martin — faint penciled grid paintings

ef9.verdict: A faint vertical lattice with a single bright pinpoint sits nearly invisible against a vast black field, far below the >10% occupancy bar — the form barely reads at all and the motion is imperceptible. Near-empty render rather than a legible structure.
ef9.resembles: a dim long-exposure of a distant radio-telescope mast at night

f0p.verdict: Neon cyan/magenta/green foam-bubbles stack upward from a baseline — a legible growth motion, but the palette is hard-banned oversaturated pop-art neon and the form reads as generic chromatic-aberration foam with no recognizable silhouette.
f0p.resembles: rising soap-foam bubbles with RGB chromatic-aberration glitch

f8e.verdict: Loud neon magenta/green/cyan calligraphic ribbons sprawl across black with no single coherent form — the palette reads as vibrant pop, exactly the oversaturated mode the gallery rejects, and the strokes scatter rather than resolve. Motion sweeps the ribbons legibly but the composition stays chaotic and unfocused.

fb2.verdict: A static-filled gray square sitting in black voids of recognizable form or silhouette — pure confined TV-noise that barely changes across the loop, the exact noise-blob failure mode the gallery rejects. No legible structure or contemplative motion emerges, just a vibrating granular patch.
fb2.resembles: analog television static (snow noise) framed in a window

fb9.verdict: A thin gold filament pinned dead-center occupies barely 3-4% of the frame in a vast black void, violating the tiny-subject-in-empty-canvas rule; motion is nearly imperceptible across the six tiles so no growth or form ever resolves.
fb9.resembles: a single suspended strand of gold leaf — like one thread from Tomás Saraceno's 'Galaxies Forming Along Filaments'

fdc.verdict: An amorphous oval cloud of confetti-like specks that never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — the restrained rust/gold/ash palette is pleasant, but the gentle drifting/breathing motion only shuffles the blob rather than revealing a form.

gif.verdict: A chaotic white triangulated mesh that clumps, collapses to a near-empty sliver, then re-knots — never resolving to a legible silhouette, while a stray dot floats in a vast empty lower half. Motion is erratic rather than contemplative and the form fails to occupy the frame.

gnc.verdict: A sparse scatter of black line segments on cream reads as a restrained constructivist sketch, but the structure is thin and the motion across frames is so slight it barely registers as a living loop. Tasteful palette and the line-as-form approach keep it from failing, yet the composition is too empty and forgettable to earn the wall.

htb.verdict: A shimmering gold-and-white particle mound that twinkles in place but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — restrained gold-on-black palette is on-brand, yet the form stays a fuzzy glitter blob with low, undirected motion.
htb.resembles: Refik Anadol — Machine Hallucinations (data-dust shimmer field)

i1n.verdict: Faint, thin scattered thread-trails in a restrained palette, but the form never resolves into a readable structure — it stays a dim, sparse tangle of arcs that barely registers against the black, and the slow drift adds no legible motion or growth.

iwd.verdict: Scattered copper shards drifting on a near-empty midnight field — no coherent silhouette emerges, and the sparse fragments thin out to almost nothing by the final frames, occupying well under 10% of the canvas. The rust-on-ink palette is appropriately restrained, but the form is illegible debris rather than an intentional structure.
iwd.resembles: drifting debris field / scattered mica flakes on dark water

j1n.verdict: A loose cloud of cyan code-glyphs suspended in a transparent wireframe box with a cyan node and a red ringed orb — reads as a generic sci-fi data-HUD rather than a resolved form, and the slow camera orbit doesn't cohere the scattered text into a recognizable silhouette. The teal-on-black palette also skews neon rather than aged/restrained.
j1n.resembles: Ryoji Ikeda — data.tron / test pattern (text-as-data datascape)

j1r.verdict: All six frames are a near-flat cream gradient with no discernible form — only faint specks drift at the lower edge; effectively an empty render with no structure or motion to read.

j3w.verdict: A featureless blown-out white blob breathing against black — no internal structure, no recognizable silhouette, just a solid mass whose edge wobbles slightly. Formless and near-empty of information despite filling the frame.
j3w.resembles: an overexposed lunar/solar disc — closest to a featureless Hiroshi Sugimoto seascape sun, but without the atmosphere

jx5.verdict: A thin horizontal lens of gold dust that gently breathes and flattens but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — restrained earth-toned palette is right, yet the form stays a flat blob. Motion is appropriately unhurried but reads as settling dust rather than intentional structure.
jx5.resembles: a protoplanetary accretion disc / cosmic dust cloud

k9s.verdict: A ghostly sphere with faint gray vein-like crackle reads as a recognizable spherical form, but the cream-on-white palette is so washed-out the piece is barely visible — it hovers at the near-empty failure mode despite legible surface structure. Motion is an unhurried slow surface drift, which is appropriate, but cannot rescue contrast this thin.
k9s.resembles: a weathered marble globe / lunar cartography sphere

kuk.verdict: Near-empty cream canvas with only faint, ghostly wisps barely above the background; no legible form emerges and the motion across frames is imperceptible, reading as a washed-out, almost-blank render.
kuk.resembles: faint condensation on glass / barely-developed photographic fog

loo.verdict: Blocky neon-green voxel cubes drift and disassemble against a near-empty black field, occupying a small fraction of the frame with no coherent organic or mathematical form; the saturated emerald reads as vibrant pop rather than the restrained patina the gallery wants. Motion is an unremarkable scatter-and-reassemble of loose boxes that never resolves into a legible whole.

luw.verdict: A small wispy luminous tangle drifts and reorients in a vast near-empty frame, occupying well under 10% of the canvas; the form never resolves into a legible silhouette and reads as a faint floating ember rather than an intentional structure.
luw.resembles: a guttering candle flame / wisp seen in the dark (à la a Brian Eno ambient light study)

mw3.verdict: Restrained gold-on-midnight palette reads well, but the form is just faint vertical curtains of drifting particle dust with no recognizable silhouette — mostly empty black with a slow, contemplative downward drift. Thin, ambient, and forgettable rather than an intentional form.
mw3.resembles: drifting embers / gold dust (sparkler fall-off), à la Olafur Eliasson's atmospheric particulate works

nss.verdict: Two tiny ink-and-rust dots tethered by a faint thread, drifting slowly across a mostly empty cream field — the subject occupies far under 10% of frame and reads as a thin, near-formless dumbbell rather than an intentional structure. Motion is unhurried but there is almost nothing to follow.
nss.resembles: Joan Miró — a stray Constellation glyph (two dots and a connecting line) floating in empty ground

o0i.verdict: A tangled knot of neon ribbons (red, cyan, lime, purple) churns in an ovoid mass with no recognizable silhouette; the palette is loud and oversaturated and the motion reads as chaotic writhing rather than legible form. Closing frame even shows glitchy scan-line artifacts.
o0i.resembles: Jackson Pollock — drip-painting tangle rendered as 3D calligraphic ribbons

om7.verdict: A small white blob drifting slowly rightward across a dark trapezoidal plane over a faint cream background — the form is an unrecognizable amorphous shape with no generative structure, and the motion is a thin, near-static slide. Reads as a tabletop with a stray pebble rather than an intentional form.
om7.resembles: a single amoeba / paramecium drifting on a microscope slide

p3f.verdict: A single hairline vertical streak (white fading to faint cyan) hangs in a near-empty black field, occupying well under 10% of the frame; across all six tiles it barely changes, so the motion reads as static and the form is too thin and tiny to register as intentional structure.
p3f.resembles: a single seismograph trace / oscilloscope scan-line

p5w.verdict: A blown-out cream-white orb with faint internal speckle that dissipates into uniform overexposure — a glowing blob with no recognizable silhouette or emergent structure, and the motion is just a gentle fade/shrink rather than legible form. Sits small and isolated in a vast black frame, hitting two gallery failure modes at once.
p5w.resembles: backlit dandelion seed head (Taraxacum clock) dissolving

p5x.verdict: A scattered field of gold-and-white blobs drifting and clustering with no emergent silhouette or structure — the gold-on-midnight palette is on-aesthetic, but the form reads as pixelated dot-noise that never resolves, and the motion is undirected milling rather than contemplative growth.
p5x.resembles: Yayoi Kusama — gold-on-black polka-dot infinity field

p8t.verdict: A restrained white-on-black duotone column reads as an upward smear of particles, but it never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — a noisy vertical haze that wobbles and drifts rather than growing into form. Palette is right, structure is thin illegible mush.
p8t.resembles: a vertical curtain of falling sand / Idris Khan layered charcoal smudge

p9y.verdict: A flat trapezoidal sheet of fine grayish static with faint magenta specks; no silhouette, no readable form, and the motion across all six tiles is imperceptible — pure formless noise rather than structured abstraction. This is the ac2/noise-blob failure mode the gallery explicitly culls.
p9y.resembles: analog TV static / dead-channel snow (CRT noise)

pa2.verdict: Two fuzzy particle clusters drift slightly against a vast empty black field with no recognizable silhouette — formless haze occupying a small corner of the frame, and the barely-perceptible motion never resolves into a readable form.
pa2.resembles: a distant pair of unresolved galaxies / Hubble deep-field smudge

pyb.verdict: A chaotic tangle of straight line-segments in clashing primary red/blue/yellow that never resolves into a recognizable form, and the loop barely changes across frames so the motion adds no legible development. The vivid-primary palette is exactly the loud, unrestrained look the wall avoids.
pyb.resembles: Naum Gabo — linear constructions in space (but degraded into a multicolor wireframe scribble)

r5j.verdict: Opens as a restrained rust-on-midnight horizontal ember field with faint flow-field striations, but the form thins as it disperses into a sparse, near-formless drifting starfield with no recognizable silhouette. The palette is on-brand, the structure is not.
r5j.resembles: drifting embers cooling from a bonfire / Refik Anadol data-field dispersal

rtd.verdict: A featureless horizontal band of gold grain on black with no silhouette or structure — reads as recolored TV static; motion is imperceptible jitter across frames, not a form evolving. The gold-on-midnight palette is on-aesthetic but cannot rescue a formless noise field.
rtd.resembles: Ryoji Ikeda — test pattern signal noise

to8.verdict: A thin vertical column of cream particles densest at top and fading to sparse dots below — restrained monochrome and contemplative, but the silhouette reads as a generic fading dust-fall rather than a recognizable form, and motion across the six frames is nearly imperceptible. Competent palette can't rescue weak, near-static structure.
to8.resembles: sand falling through an hourglass / settling sediment

ty4.verdict: Restrained dusk palette with a glowing moon is atmospheric, but the central form is a fuzzy block-cluster blob with no recognizable silhouette, and the loop is nearly static so nothing resolves into intentional structure.
ty4.resembles: Caspar David Friedrich — Moonrise Over the Sea (nocturne mood), but the subject reads as a blocky pixelated shrub

uqw.verdict: A tangle of nested wireframe boxes in loud red/yellow/blue/white primaries reads as muddy, illegible scaffolding rather than a coherent form; the cross-frame motion is a slight rotational wobble that never resolves into a readable shape. The vivid primary palette is exactly the 'neon/pop' register the gallery rejects.
uqw.resembles: Manfred Mohr — algorithmic hypercube line projections

v0t.verdict: A sparse, loosely-clustered field of pale-gold and cream squares drifting gently on black — palette is restrained and motion is unhurried, but the points never resolve into a recognizable silhouette, reading as scattered dust rather than an intentional form.
v0t.resembles: a firefly swarm (Photinus) drifting at dusk

vg3.verdict: A thin wireframe rectangle bisected by a scratchy horizontal trace with a faint particle smudge inside — palette is nicely restrained cream-on-bone and the breathing motion is contemplative, but the form is sparse and forgettable, reading more as a stray UI frame than an intentional structure.

vs1.verdict: A tiny symmetric white glyph-like form floats in a vast black void, occupying well under 10% of the frame and reading as an illegible blob rather than a recognizable structure; the slow per-frame morphing is contemplative but there is too little form to carry the canvas.

vtg.verdict: A single flat, grainy dark-grey square slowly tumbling on black — the form is trivial geometry rather than emergent structure, and the near-black-on-black contrast leaves it barely legible. The rotation is unhurried but reads as a spinning placeholder card, not a composed particle field.
vtg.resembles: Kazimir Malevich — Black Square (set in motion)

wfg.verdict: A static dusk-gradient sky with sparse, barely-visible flecks — the restrained earth-toned palette is on-brand but there is no legible form and almost no perceptible motion across the loop, reading as near-empty ambient haze. Falls into the 'tiny subjects in vast empty canvas' / formless failure mode.
wfg.resembles: a faint long-exposure twilight starfield (Wolfgang Tillmans' dim astronomical photographs)

wox.verdict: A flat horizontal haze of cream particles drifts gently over a dark terrain with an undulating red contour line, but the cloud never resolves into a recognizable silhouette and reads as ambient noise-blob rather than intentional form. The restrained bone-on-ink palette and unhurried motion keep it from scoring lower, but the structure is thin and forgettable.
wox.resembles: windblown dust haze / haboob drifting over a desert ridge

wyz.verdict: A blown-out white slab fills each tile with no readable silhouette or internal structure, and across the six frames it only twitches at the edges — neither a coherent form nor legible motion emerges. Reads as an overexposed or broken render rather than a composed piece.

x0l.verdict: Opens as a faint radial urchin-burst but immediately disperses into a uniform field of formless white speckle that fills the frame; the motion is dissolution into static, not contemplative growth, and no silhouette survives.
x0l.resembles: dandelion seed-head (Taraxacum) dispersing into TV static

x6y.verdict: A handsome dusk gradient dominates while the actual particle form is a barely-visible faint wisp occupying well under 10% of frame; motion is so slight across the six tiles it reads as near-static, leaving no legible structure to read.
x6y.resembles: a faint Geminid meteor shower over a twilight horizon

xuh.verdict: A single hair-thin vertical green-and-white streak hangs in a vast black void, occupying barely 2-3% of the frame; the form is too thin and isolated to read as a deliberate composition, and motion across the loop is nearly imperceptible.
xuh.resembles: a vertical seismograph/oscilloscope trace, or a lone bioluminescent siphonophore filament

xv9.verdict: A soft, defocused bokeh blob of blue-white-purple orbs that drifts and breathes gently but never resolves into a recognizable silhouette — pleasant haze, no form. Motion is unhurried but the structure is just an amorphous oval cloud, exactly the ambient-nebula failure mode.
xv9.resembles: Leo Villareal — soft LED point-field (e.g. 'Multiverse'), seen badly out of focus

y2k.verdict: A single thin calligraphic stroke drifting almost imperceptibly across the loop — restrained ink-on-cream palette is right, but the form is one wispy line occupying far under 10% of the frame with motion too slight to read as intentional. Thin structure in vast empty canvas.
y2k.resembles: a single sumi-e brush stroke (Japanese calligraphic ensō fragment)

yik.verdict: Soft gold and pale-blue glows drift on a flat tilted gray plane with no recognizable silhouette — the ambient noise-blob failure mode, and motion across the loop is nearly imperceptible. Reads as out-of-focus haze rather than an intentional form.
yik.resembles: Mark Rothko color-field haze (blurred luminous blobs, no structure)

ym5.verdict: A small knot of angular cream-and-brown shards hovers in a vast black field, reading as an illegible tangle rather than a resolved form; motion is near-static with only slight settling, so the piece never coheres into something intentional and sits below the >10%-of-frame threshold.

yy3.verdict: A flat horizontal mat of vivid primary-colored cubes (red/yellow/blue) that ripples gently left-to-right, but the palette reads as loud pop-art confetti and the form is a thin, formless carpet with no silhouette or vertical structure — most of the frame is empty cream above it.
yy3.resembles: wind-rippled field of confetti / a waving pixelated cloth-sim flag

z3q.verdict: A dense gold-grain field on black with two faint vertical smudges that never resolve into a legible form across the loop; the palette is handsomely restrained but the structure is essentially textured noise with near-static, barely-perceptible motion.
z3q.resembles: Vija Celmins — Night Sky (dense granular field)

zrd.verdict: Lumpy sphere-packed mass reads as a berry/cell cluster but the hot-magenta with rainbow chromatic-aberration fringing is exactly the oversaturated neon palette the gallery bans; motion is a barely-perceptible breathing wobble that adds little.

zs1.verdict: A low brown mound under a cream sky with sparse dust-flecks barely shifts across the loop — restrained earth palette but the form is a near-featureless horizontal band with no legible silhouette or structure. Motion is so slight it reads as static, not contemplative growth.
zs1.resembles: Mark Rothko — horizontal color-field band (cream-over-earth), or a distant wind-rippled sand dune horizon

zst.verdict: A tiny illegible smudge of pale specks hovers in a vast empty dusk-to-rust gradient, occupying far less than 10% of frame; the cluster barely drifts across the loop, reading as near-empty rather than as any intentional form.
zst.resembles: a distant starling murmuration seen too far away to resolve
